nuggets.text: Tony Phillips Jr. returned the opening kickoff of the Tigers' season 89 yards for a touchdown against Clark Atlanta.
Reginald Johnson completed 15 of 17 passes in the Tigers' 49-7 season-opening rout of Clark Atlanta.
Six different Tigers ran for touchdowns in Grambling's 48-26 win over Central State.
Legendary Grambling coach Eddie Robinson once also directed the band and ran the cheerleaders, on a budget of $46.
Grambling and Morgan State played in Tokyo in 1976, the first time US college football teams played a game in Asia.
Grambling's band performed at Super Bowls I and II, before the NFL title game was even officially called the Super Bowl.
President Bill Clinton played saxophone with Grambling's band during a 1999 halftime show in Grambling, Louisiana.
Grambling alum Doug Williams was the first Black quarterback to start and win a Super Bowl, with Washington in Super Bowl XXII.
Tigers coach Mickey Joseph is the older brother of Vance Joseph, who was hired as Denver Broncos head coach in 2017.
The Tigers and Horned Frogs meet for just the second time; the only other meeting was in Fort Worth in 2012.
